title: Sorting and trimming the products table

steps.title: Sort id smallest first
steps.prompt:
ORDER BY puts rows in a tidy line.
Add DESC to flip from smallest-first to biggest-first.
steps.task: Try typing: SELECT id FROM products ORDER BY id ;
hints: Start with SELECT id FROM products.
Add ORDER BY id.
Add DESC for biggest-first (leave it out for smallest).
Write: SELECT id FROM products ORDER BY id ;
steps.expected_sql: SELECT id FROM products ORDER BY id ;
steps.memory_trick: DESC = descending = biggest on top.

steps.title: Sort id biggest first
steps.prompt:
ORDER BY puts rows in a tidy line.
Add DESC to flip from smallest-first to biggest-first.
steps.task: Try typing: SELECT id FROM products ORDER BY id DESC;
hints: Start with SELECT id FROM products.
Add ORDER BY id.
Add DESC for biggest-first (leave it out for smallest).
Write: SELECT id FROM products ORDER BY id DESC;
steps.expected_sql: SELECT id FROM products ORDER BY id DESC;
steps.memory_trick: DESC = descending = biggest on top.

steps.title: Top 1 by id
steps.prompt:
LIMIT cuts the list after N rows.
Sort first, then keep only 1.
steps.task: Try typing: SELECT id FROM products ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1;
hints: Start with SELECT id FROM products.
Add ORDER BY id DESC.
Finish with LIMIT 1.
Write: SELECT id FROM products ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1;
steps.expected_sql: SELECT id FROM products ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1;
steps.memory_trick: ORDER BY then LIMIT = a top-N chart.

steps.title: The distinct values of id
steps.prompt:
DISTINCT removes duplicate rows from the result.
It answers 'which different id values exist?'
steps.task: Try typing: SELECT DISTINCT id FROM products ORDER BY id;
hints: Start with SELECT DISTINCT id.
FROM products.
Add ORDER BY id to sort them.
Write: SELECT DISTINCT id FROM products ORDER BY id;
steps.expected_sql: SELECT DISTINCT id FROM products ORDER BY id;
steps.memory_trick: DISTINCT = 'each value only once'.
